meta.name: archify
meta.description: Create polished, validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle/state diagrams as explorable standalone HTML with inline SVG, dark/light themes, optional trace motion, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/WebM export. Accept plain-language requirements or pasted Mermaid flowchart, sequenceDiagram, and stateDiagram input; inspect repository evidence when the diagram must reflect real code. Use when the user asks to visualize system architecture, infrastructure, cloud/security/network topology, technical workflows, API call sequences, request lifecycles, data pipelines, ETL/ELT, data lineage, state machines, or to convert/beautify Mermaid.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把系统结构与流程变成清晰直观的图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 需要把系统结构画出来给团队评审或留档。
copy.tagline_en: Turn system structures and flows into clear diagrams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to visualize system structure for team review or documentation.

howto.what: Claude 会把你的文字说明或粘贴的 Mermaid 图做成一个独立可打开、内置 SVG 的 HTML 示意图(架构、工作流、时序、数据流、状态等),支持深浅色主题和 PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/WebM 导出。
howto.when: 当你想把系统架构、业务流程、接口调用等画成示意图,或想把 Mermaid 图转换或美化时触发。

say.text: 把支付服务的架构画成一张 HTML 交互图。
say.note: 会生成独立可打开的 HTML 示意图。

say.text: 美化这段 Mermaid 时序图并导出为 HTML。
参照仓库里的实际代码,画订单服务的模块架构图。
say.note: 会先查阅仓库证据再成图。

howto.what_en: Claude turns plain-language descriptions or pasted Mermaid into a standalone openable HTML diagram (architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, lifecycle/state) with inline SVG, dark/light themes, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/WebM export.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want system architecture, workflows, API sequences, etc. drawn as diagrams, or when you ask to convert or beautify Mermaid input.

say_en.text: Draw the payment service architecture as an interactive HTML diagram.
Beautify this Mermaid sequence diagram and export it as HTML.
say_en.note: Re-lays it out without changing meaning.

say_en.text: Map the order service architecture from this repository's real code.
